Ikhowudi inefom yokubhala 'oonobumba abakhulu abangu-a' kuqala emva koko 'amanani angu-d' (umzekelo, ukuba a=2 kwaye d=3, ikhowudi enje nge-KT482). Okokuqala, inani leekhowudi ezahlukeneyo ezinokwenziwa kufuneka libe zizinto ezingama-30,000 ubuncinane eziza kusetyenziswa ukususela ngoku. Okwesibini, ukuze kungabikho iikhowudi ezininzi ezingasetyenziswanga, kufuneka zibe ngama-600,000 ubuninzi. Okwesithathu, ubude bekhowudi a + d kufuneka bube yi-5 ubuninzi.
